purpose: Verify workflow transition from sender to recipient with zero onward-forward traversal.
preconditions: Active circulated file held by Sender; valid Recipient employee exists.
action_or_input: Sender executes Forward with mandatory movement comment and optional attachment.
expected_result: File transitions to Active/Circulated held by Recipient; movement history and audit are updated; notification is triggered; no further forward occurs.

purpose: Verify onward-forwarding workflow transition representing exactly one loop traversal.
preconditions: Active circulated file held by Current Recipient; valid Next Recipient exists.
action_or_input: Current Recipient forwards file onward to Next Recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File transitions to Active/Circulated held by Next Recipient; movement history appends onward forward; notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify workflow return transition from current recipient back to the previous sender.
preconditions: Active circulated file held by Current Recipient with known previous sender.
action_or_input: Current Recipient initiates Return with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File transitions to Active/Circulated held by Previous Sender; return movement is recorded chronologically; return notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify lifecycle-closing archival transition executed by the file owner.
preconditions: Active circulated file where collaborative objective is complete; actor is the file owner.
action_or_input: File owner selects Archive.
expected_result: File transitions from Active to Archived / Read-only / Permanently retained; subsequent modification and forwarding are locked; archival notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify initial draft creation step of BW-FTS-05 with zero draft-edit traversal.
preconditions: No FTS file record for the intended file; employee has authorized role.
action_or_input: Employee creates file with initial mandatory comment and saves as draft.
expected_result: File transitions from Non-existent to Draft / Pre-circulation state.

purpose: Verify initial circulation step of BW-FTS-05 with zero draft-edit traversal.
preconditions: File in Draft / Pre-circulation state; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Sender submits file to recipient with mandatory movement comment without prior draft editing.
expected_result: File transitions from Draft / Pre-circulation to Active / Circulated held by Recipient.

purpose: Verify draft creation step of BW-FTS-06.
preconditions: No FTS file record for intended file; employee has authorized role.
action_or_input: Employee creates new file with initial mandatory comment and saves as draft.
expected_result: File enters Draft / Pre-circulation state.

purpose: Verify one draft-edit traversal step of BW-FTS-06.
preconditions: File in Draft / Pre-circulation state.
action_or_input: Employee edits draft comment and attachments, then saves.
expected_result: File transitions to Updated Draft / Pre-circulation state.

purpose: Verify circulation step of BW-FTS-06 following one draft edit.
preconditions: File in Updated Draft / Pre-circulation state; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Sender submits updated draft to recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File transitions from Updated Draft to Active / Circulated state held by Recipient.

purpose: Verify draft creation step of BW-FTS-07.
preconditions: No FTS file record; employee has authorized role.
action_or_input: Employee creates new file with mandatory comment and saves as draft.
expected_result: File enters Draft / Pre-circulation state.

purpose: Verify draft discard step of BW-FTS-07 with zero draft edit.
preconditions: File in Draft / Pre-circulation state.
action_or_input: Employee chooses Discard before submission or editing.
expected_result: File transitions from Draft to Discarded; no active file is retained.

purpose: Verify draft creation step of BW-FTS-08.
preconditions: No FTS file record; employee has authorized role.
action_or_input: Employee creates new file with mandatory comment and saves as draft.
expected_result: File enters Draft / Pre-circulation state.

purpose: Verify one draft-edit traversal step of BW-FTS-08.
preconditions: File in Draft / Pre-circulation state.
action_or_input: Employee edits draft content and saves.
expected_result: File transitions to Updated Draft / Pre-circulation state.

purpose: Verify draft discard step of BW-FTS-08 following one draft edit.
preconditions: File in Updated Draft / Pre-circulation state.
action_or_input: Employee chooses Discard on the updated draft before submission.
expected_result: File transitions from Updated Draft to Discarded; no active file is retained.

purpose: Verify compound workflow path 1: forward from sender to recipient followed by owner archival upon completion.
preconditions: Circulated file held by Sender (who is owner); valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Owner forwards file to recipient with comment; after collaboration, owner archives the completed file.
expected_result: File transitions: Active(Sender) -> Active(Recipient) -> Archived(Owner); complete lifecycle closure.

purpose: Verify compound workflow path 2: forward to recipient followed by return to previous sender.
preconditions: Active file held by Sender; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Sender forwards to recipient; recipient returns file to previous sender.
expected_result: File transitions: Active(Sender) -> Active(Recipient) -> Active(Previous Sender); movement history records forward and return.

purpose: Verify compound workflow path 3: forward to recipient, onward forward to next recipient, then return to prior sender.
preconditions: Active file held by Employee A; valid recipients B and C exist.
action_or_input: A forwards to B, B forwards onward to C, C returns to B.
expected_result: File transitions: Active(A) -> Active(B) -> Active(C) -> Active(B); holder updates consistently.

purpose: Verify compound workflow path 4: forward to recipient, onward forward to next recipient, followed by owner archival.
preconditions: Active file created by owner A; valid recipients B and C exist.
action_or_input: A forwards to B, B forwards onward to C; collaborative objective completes; owner A archives the file.
expected_result: File transitions: Active(A) -> Active(B) -> Active(C) -> Archived; file locked in read-only state.

purpose: Verify compound workflow path 5: forward, return to sender, re-forward, and completion archival.
preconditions: Active file created by owner A; valid recipient B exists.
action_or_input: A forwards to B, B returns to A, A re-forwards to B, owner A archives upon completion.
expected_result: All state transitions succeed and are recorded in full chronological sequence.

purpose: Verify compound workflow path 1: create draft and discard before circulation without edit.
preconditions: No file exists; authorized creator.
action_or_input: Creator creates draft, then chooses Discard before submission.
expected_result: Transitions: None -> Draft -> Discarded; terminal outcome reached before circulation.

purpose: Verify compound workflow path 2: create draft, edit once, and discard before circulation.
preconditions: No file exists; authorized creator.
action_or_input: Creator creates draft, edits draft once, then chooses Discard.
expected_result: Transitions: None -> Draft -> Updated Draft -> Discarded; terminal outcome reached after one edit.

purpose: Verify compound workflow path 3: create draft and circulate directly to recipient without edit.
preconditions: No file exists; authorized creator; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Creator creates draft, then submits directly to recipient with mandatory comment.
expected_result: Transitions: None -> Draft -> Active/Circulated(Recipient); file successfully enters collaborative circulation.

purpose: Verify compound workflow path 4: create draft, edit once, and circulate to recipient.
preconditions: No file exists; authorized creator; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Creator creates draft, edits draft once, then submits to recipient with mandatory comment.
expected_result: Transitions: None -> Draft -> Updated Draft -> Active/Circulated(Recipient); file enters circulation with edited content.
